name: StartupBase

sources.title: StartupBase homepage — daily launches, DR 74+ backlink pitch

requirements: Account required — new accounts are created via Google, LinkedIn, or X OAuth only; email sign-in is restricted to existing accounts and cannot create one
Products launch daily ('New launches every day at 12:00 AM PDT')
Some listings carry a 'Premium' badge — a paid tier exists but pricing was not visible on public pages
preparation: A Google, LinkedIn or X account (email-only signup is not supported)
Product name, tagline/description, logo, categories (broad taxonomy e.g. B2B, AI Tools, Marketplaces)
Optional discount/promo text — some listings display offers like '30% off for 3 months'
workflow: Open startupbase.io/submit or the 'Launch' nav item
Continue with Google, LinkedIn, or X (account is created automatically)
Complete the product submission form in the dashboard
Product is queued for a daily launch (12:00 AM PDT drops)
Listing appears on the Today board and keeps a permanent page
watchFor: Email field is a trap for new users — it only sends sign-in codes to EXISTING accounts; use OAuth
A 'Premium' marker on some listings implies a paid route whose price/terms are not published on public pages
Homepage pitch is 'earn a DR 74+ backlink' — whether the free tier's link is dofollow is not stated
Advertise page exists for paid placements
countsAsLive: The product appears on the daily 'Today' board with its own detail page after its launch date.
unknowns: Premium tier pricing and exact benefits
Whether free listings are human-reviewed and on what timeline
Whether the free listing's outbound link is dofollow
